title: Правила и необходимость
description: Различаем запрет и отсутствие необходимости в знакомых бытовых ситуациях.
objectives: Различить mustn't и don't have to
Использовать have to для практической необходимости
notes: Don't have to означает отсутствие необходимости: можно, но не обязательно.

exercises.prompt: Выбери значение You don't have to bring lunch.
exercises.explanation: Don't have to снимает обязанность, а не запрещает действие.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.

public_payload.sentence: The sign says NO SMOKING. You ___ smoke here.

exercises.explanation: Знак запрещает курить, поэтому требуется mustn't.

exercises.editorial_answer: You have to show your ticket at the entrance.
exercises.explanation: Have to описывает требование предъявить билет.

public_payload.sentence: She doesn't has to work on Sunday.

accepted: She doesn't have to work on Sunday.

exercises.reference_answer: She doesn't have to work on Sunday.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She doesn't has to work on Sunday.
exercises.editorial_answer: She doesn't have to work on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: После doesn't используется have, не has.

public_payload.source: Тебе не обязательно вставать рано завтра.

accepted: You don't have to get up early tomorrow.
You do not have to get up early tomorrow.

exercises.reference_answer: You don't have to get up early tomorrow.
exercises.incorrect_answer: You mustn't get up early tomorrow.
exercises.editorial_answer: You don't have to get up early tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Отсутствие необходимости передаёт don't have to; mustn't был бы запретом.

options.label: Visitors can bring one, but it is not necessary.
Visitors are forbidden to bring one.
Every visitor must buy a new one.

public_payload.passage: Visitors to the sports centre have to show a membership card at the entrance. They must not run beside the swimming pool. Towels are available for a small fee, so visitors do not have to bring their own. Children under twelve must be with an adult in the pool area. The café is open to everyone.

exercises.editorial_answer: Visitors can bring one, but it is not necessary.
exercises.explanation: Do not have to bring their own означает, что своё полотенце необязательно.

options.label: Yes, everyone has to wear one.
Yes, you don't have to wear one.

lines.speaker: New member
lines.text: Do I have to wear a swimming cap?

exercises.editorial_answer: Yes, everyone has to wear one.
exercises.explanation: Yes и has to согласованно сообщают об обязательности.

public_payload.sentence: Her shift starts at seven, so she ___ leave home early.

exercises.explanation: С she используется has to; после must частица to не ставится.
